epic.name: Cinopsis Plan C — Viewer Refresh + Refraction Surface
qualityGates: Render viewer/viewer.html against a real multi-video session; assert every analysis panel populates and the browser console is error-free (browser-verifier).
decisions: UI/interaction only. The data layer — fetch, analysis, and the _has_analysis promotion (compare_server.py:369) — is untouched; that is Plan A's.
USE /prism:cl-plugin-structure for the interactive surface; never edit that skill. Reconcile across surfaces later via /prism:fragment-sync (Plan B).
viewer/viewer.html stays a single self-contained file: assets (mark SVG, favicon) are inlined as data URIs, not external paths.
Griotwave tokens and the 'wave' (ember) logo variant are consumed from existing assets, not redesigned.
The graph reads existing analysis.topics/disagreements/key_moments from comparison_data.json — no new backend or pipeline.

sendPrompt() exists only when the viewer is embedded in a Cowork widget host — NOT in the Flask-served browser view (localhost:5123). drive() buttons must feature-detect and no-op gracefully; the true refraction surface is a Cowork-embedded rendering path.
references: Cowork session 00791624 (Lucid griot-suite consolidation) — sendPrompt CTA + clickable layer/card widget patterns
outOfScope: Any fetch / transcript / ASR change (Plan A).
Changing the _has_analysis promotion logic (Plan A invariant, locked).
A new analysis pipeline or backend — the graph reads existing fields only.
Native (electron/vscode) drive() parity — via Fragment (Plan B rollout).
risks: viewer.html is an 89 KB hand-authored single file — the restyle must preserve inline JS selectors and data bindings.
sendPrompt is host-specific: the Flask browser view has no sendPrompt, so C4 must feature-detect or the buttons appear broken.
A large session can clutter the node-graph — cap nodes / simplify layout.
grounding: viewer.html is 2170 lines and ALREADY token-based: :root at lines 10-21 (--bg #0f1117, --panel-bg #0d0f1a, --card-bg #1a1d2e, --text-primary #e2e8f0, --brand-purple #a78bfa, --active-purple #7c3aed). C1 is a token REMAP to Griotwave ember + glass, not a rewrite.
Tab system exists: switchTab() + .nav-tab buttons in #nav-bar (viewer.html:726-735 - Dashboard / By Topic / By Video). C3 adds a 'Connections' tab the same way; C4's control row lives in #nav-bar.

Analysis fields destructured at viewer.html:1083-1086 (analysis.topics / disagreements / key_moments / unified_summary) and re-collected at 1741-1749 - the graph reads from there. statCard() at ~1098 is the existing render helper.
Header title = #nav-session-title (viewer.html:730); existing button onclick pattern at 711/733 is the model for C4's drive() buttons.

stories.title: Griotwave token pass on viewer.html
stories.description: Replace ad-hoc styles in viewer/viewer.html with Griotwave tokens (glass surfaces, ember accents, type scale, Afrik wordmark header) while preserving the existing layout and every JS data binding.

steps.description: Read viewer/viewer.html fully; inventory the existing CSS (colors, fonts, layout) and every JS data-binding point. Do not alter bindings or element ids/classes the JS depends on.
Pull tokens from the Griotwave master (C:/Users/digit/GriotMeta/SkillsForge/griotwave/griotwave-library/_master/griotwave.tokens.json): bg, glass, ember, text, radius, blur.
Add a :root token block and map existing colors to it: glass surfaces (blur(40px) saturate(140%)), ember accent, warm off-white text. Replace ad-hoc hex with var(--...).
Set the header wordmark to Afrik (embed via @font-face data URI if available, else a styled serif fallback). Keep the layout grid intact.
Render against a real session dir; confirm all cards/panels still populate (no binding regressions) and text is legible in light + dark.

context.why: The viewer is the refraction surface; it must read as ember-bloom Griotwave while staying a single self-contained file.
risks: Restyle can break inline JS if selectors/ids change.

stories.title: Connections graph view on the cross-video panel
stories.description: Add a node-graph to the cross-video panel: nodes = videos, edges = shared topics / disagreements, edge weight ~ shared key_moments. Reads existing analysis fields from comparison_data.json; no new backend.

Add an inline SVG node-graph: one node per video, edges between videos that share a topic or co-appear in a disagreement; edge weight from shared key_moments count. Node color = per-video ember variant.

stories.title: drive() buttons in the viewer (refraction surface)
stories.description: Add interactive CTAs that advance the agent: Re-run analysis, Capture frame, Write digest, Generate icons (/griot-app-icons). Each calls a driveOrPrompt() helper that uses sendPrompt() in a Cowork widget host, a native drive bridge if present, and disables gracefully in a plain browser. Modeled on session 00791624's sendPrompt CTA pattern.

steps.description: Add a control row to the header/panel with CTAs: Re-run analysis, Capture frame, Write digest, Generate icons.

Implement driveOrPrompt(text): if typeof sendPrompt === 'function' -> sendPrompt(text) (Cowork widget host); else if a native drive bridge exists -> call it; else disable the button + tooltip 'available in Cowork / native'.

Wire each CTA to a concrete prompt. e.g. Generate icons -> 'Use /griot-app-icons on the Cinopsis mark to regenerate the viewer icon bundle.'; Re-run analysis -> 'Re-run compare analysis for session <id> and refresh the viewer.'
Guarantee the plain Flask/browser view (no sendPrompt) still fully works — buttons inert/disabled, viewer unaffected.
Verify: embedded in a Cowork widget the button injects the prompt; standalone the viewer renders and buttons no-op. Confirm cl-plugin-structure interactive-surface conformance.

context.why: The refraction surface: the read-out becomes a control that DRIVES the agent — the sendPrompt/drive pattern generalized from prism-brainstorm's click-to-wake.
risks: sendPrompt exists only in the Cowork widget host, NOT the Flask browser view -> MUST feature-detect.
edgeCases: Flask browser view (no sendPrompt) -> disabled buttons
Native surface with a drive bridge
Missing session id for the Re-run prompt
